body:
Heyllo PvPers!

This team is one that has been through a lot in the past week, switching leaders and all sorts of stuff until it got to me (formerly Retaliation led by MLGPorky.)

Hopefully we can be more active after the OCN Tourney is over.

  • Available

Subs
I have no idea who did what on the old team so pls remind me!

If you would like to join this clan, please apply using the following format:

Skype:
Online Time:
Time Zone:
Kills:
K/D Ratio:
Past clans (If any):
Clan Position:


Requirements:
  • Be an active player
  • Have at least a 1.5 KD (Exceptions can be made)
  • Have skype
  • Be able to attend scrimmages
  • Have TS3
If you are going to apply, please make sure that you will be active in the clan, and try your best to attend some scrimmages.
